# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Test
- [ ] Build

## Checklist

- [ ] I read the relevant docs before making changes.
- [ ] I kept the change scoped to one feature or fix.
- [ ] I updated documentation if architecture or behavior changed.
- [ ] TypeScript passes.
- [ ] ESLint passes.
- [ ] No secrets, session tokens, or sensitive data are logged or committed.
